checks_run.procedure: Live end-to-end API scenario on a running stack with synthetic data. Create transformations in both modes (B0009). Check that the B0018 roles, the B0023 gate names, B0029 workstreams, B0056 design questions, B0062 canvas prompts and B0039-B0043 scope checks are verbatim. Check that G2 and G3 are refused before G1. Exercise the charter: the 14 fields, versions, the 3-5 top-outcome warning, the four-part thesis and incomplete parts, Out of scope and B0041. Check exactly one current North Star, the good outcome test, zero guardrails blocking G2, the T01 six dimensions and H/M/L, and the T02 target date. Then walk Diagnose→Define→Design with G1, G2 and G3 decisions by a separate demo Sponsor. Round 5 additions: (a) the F-DG2-180 classes are refused on Out of scope: VS16 only, VS16+CGJ, U+0001, a lone U+D800, Mongolian FVS1, a tag character, a Khmer inherent vowel and RLM+LRM+ALM; (b) Arabic charter text with RLM/ALM/isolates in 7 fields plus the change summary is stored verbatim and B0041 passes; (c) a 200-character Arabic name (401 bytes) is accepted and 201 characters are refused; char_length counts code points; (d) an emoji with VS16 is accepted; (e) an Arabic outcome, archive reason and North Star with RLM are accepted verbatim.
checks_run.environment: disposable PG16 cluster :54985 (UTF8 db), API AUTH_MODE=dev :3985, seed-dev SYNTHETIC users, Node 24.21.0, TZ Asia/Riyadh
checks_run.expected: every assertion PASS; G1 approved → define; G2 approved → design; G3 approved → mobilize; G4-G6 stay draft
checks_run.actual: SUMMARY pass 99, fail []. G1→define, G2→design and G3→mobilize happened in sequence. G2 and G3 before G1, and G3 before G2, were refused with 422. Final gates: G1, G2 and G3 approved; G4, G5 and G6 draft. Every R5 case passed: 8 invisible classes 400 validation.blank with the version unchanged; Arabic with RLM verbatim in all 7 fields and the summary; 200 Arabic characters accepted and 201 refused (validation.too_big); char_length/octet_length 23/46; emoji+VS16 accepted; Arabic outcome, reason and North Star with RLM verbatim. Note: the label of R5.db-stores-codepoints says '22 chars', but the assertion compares against the real code-point count (23, including the two RLMs).

A capability links to a T03 gap with a sourcing need. A journey's cycle time is a decimal; a pain point links to a T01 row. Conversion without an owner is refused; with an owner it creates the Open decision D-03 linked to the item. The dimension view returns cell/dimension/gaps/decisions/dependencies/evidence.

Conversion without an owner returns 400; with an owner it returns 200 and D-03 is open with the owner set. Arabic+RLM text was verbatim in T04, T03, the pain point and the workshop item. Two earlier runs had harness errors (I expected exactly 400 where the product returns 422 for a business rule, and I used the invalid dimension code 'governance'). I corrected them; they were not product defects.

D-065 (wider invisible-content rule, OIDC display name, UTF8 database) refuses no legitimate playbook or Arabic input: Arabic with RLM/ALM/isolates is stored verbatim, and length limits count characters.
